_comment: Guided tour for Ninja Adventure. The window is one canvas, so the tour covers what the game is, who the keyboard belongs to, and where the rest lives.

steps.title: A walk beside the work
steps.text: This is the ported Ninja Adventure map in a dockable canvas — something to walk while a fit runs. It ships with ChiSurf but sits behind the demo-plugins switch: a tile-map game is not why someone opens a fitting program.

steps.title: The keyboard follows the focus
steps.text: The game takes the arrow keys only while the canvas has focus. Click anywhere else in ChiSurf and the keys are back to the application — Escape hands them over without moving the mouse.

await.hint: Click into the map and take a few steps with the arrow keys.

steps.title: Talk to the village
steps.text: Walk up to someone and press Space or Return to interact. The world is small on purpose: the map is a carrier, not a campaign — the review-attachment phase attaches to real actions, not to wandering.

steps.title: It comes back as you left it
steps.text: The window remembers where it was between sessions through the shared plugin-state mechanism. The game logic lives in game.py with its own tests — including the one that checks nothing walks through a wall.
